---
title: "Under the hood"
description: "How the Claude suggestion workflows work, step by step, and which R function does what."
---

This page is for anyone who wants to know what the
[roxygen](roxygen-suggest.qmd) and [test](test-suggest.qmd) suggestion
workflows actually do — to trust a suggestion, to adjust a setting, or to
debug a run. You don't need it to use them.

Two principles run through both workflows:

- **Claude returns fields, R builds the result.** Claude never writes a
  finished roxygen block or `test_that()` call. It fills in a fixed form
  (a *tool call*: title, parameters, test assertions, a reason for each
  change, …), and R functions check those fields and assemble the file.
  So Claude can't break the file format, drop a tag, or skip the reason.
- **Nothing is proposed unchecked.** R filters every change by its stated
  reason ([what gets proposed](suggestions.qmd#what-gets-proposed)), and
  every new or changed test is run before it is proposed.

All R code lives in
[`R/functions/`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/tree/main/R/functions)
— in `shared/` and one folder per workflow —
one function per file; the entry scripts `R/suggest_roxygen.R` and
`R/suggest_tests.R` only connect them.

## The workflow around the R script

Both workflows share the same frame. Only the R script in the middle
differs.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  subgraph prep ["Prepare"]
    direction LR
    trig(["PR, schedule<br/>or manual run"]) --> files["Choose files"]
    files --> setup["Install R and your<br/>package's dependencies"]
    setup --> token["Get a short-lived<br/>Claude token"]
  end
  subgraph run ["Suggest"]
    direction LR
    script["R script: review<br/>with Claude, write files"] --> push["Get a push token<br/>(GitHub App)"]
    push --> commit["Commit to a<br/>bot-suggest/ branch"]
    commit --> pr["Suggestion PR +<br/>comment on your PR"]
  end
  prep --> run
```

| Step | Done by | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Choose files | workflow step (shell) | In a PR: the `R/*.R` files the PR changed. In a sweep: all of them (roxygen), or the recently changed ones plus a rotating share (tests, see [sweep scope](test-suggest.qmd#sweep-scope)). Writes `files_to_check.txt`; with no files, all later steps are skipped. |
| Claude token | [`anthropic-token`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/tree/main/.github/actions/anthropic-token) action | Trades GitHub's identity token for a short-lived Claude token, see [Claude setup](claude-setup.qmd). |
| R script | `R/suggest_roxygen.R`, `R/suggest_tests.R` | Everything below. Rewrites files in place and lists them in `updated_files.txt`; writes the PR description (`suggestion_report.md`) and the summary line (`suggestion_summary.md`). |
| Push token | [`resolve-push-token`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/tree/main/.github/actions/resolve-push-token) action | A GitHub App token, so your required checks run on the suggestion PR. |
| Commit and PR | [`commit-updated-files`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/tree/main/.github/actions/commit-updated-files) action | Commits exactly the listed files, opens or updates the suggestion PR, and comments on your PR. See [how suggestions work](suggestions.qmd). |

## Shared helpers

Used by both workflows (and partly by the [author suggestions](authors-suggest.qmd),
which doesn't use Claude).

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`report_style()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/report_style.R) | Reads the report layout from `config/report-style.yml` (heading sizes, spacing). |
| [`report_heading()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/report_heading.R) | A section heading of a report, e.g. "Applied changes (8)". |
| [`report_groups()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/report_groups.R) | The collapsible groups in a report, e.g. one per file. |
| [`get_github_json()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/get_github_json.R) | Reads from the GitHub API; a failure skips that item instead of stopping the run. |
| [`post_github_json()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/post_github_json.R) | Writes to the GitHub API (comments, issues); a failure is logged, not fatal. |
